commands.description: List of bximage operations to perform (create, convert, resize, commit, info). Each entry must specify at least 'func' and 'filename1'. Optional fields depend on function type. For 'create', either 'size_fd' (floppy) or 'size_hd' (hard disk) must be specified; for 'convert'/'resize', both 'filename1' and 'filename2' are required; for 'commit', 'filename1' (base image) and 'filename2' (redolog) are required. 'imgmode' applies only to create/convert; 'backup' toggles -b flag for convert/resize/commit operations. All string values are passed directly to bximage CLI arguments without escaping or quoting beyond Jinja2 rendering. Use 'default' for missing optional string values, and 'false' for 'backup' to omit the -b flag. List items are flat objects, not nested structures.
